newsitem.title: GERMANY: Debis says expects strong sales growth.
newsitem.headline: Debis says expects strong sales growth.

text.p: The chief executive of Daimler-Benz AG unit Debis expects sales at the computer services division to almost double through the turn of the century, according to a newspaper report on Saturday.
The Stuttgarter Zeitung quoted Debis chief executive Klaus Mangold as saying sales should rise to about 20 billin marks by the year 2000 from the 1995 level of about 13.3 billion marks
Mangold said he expected 1996 sales to be about 15 percent more than last year.
He also said there was no division within Debis that had a return on capital below 18 percent.
Daimler chief executive Juergen Schrempp has set a goal at the German industrial group for each unit to have a minimum return on investment of at least 12 percent.
